description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hadirawalana Ihalagama, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kuruegala District - Cad. Map No. 420350 - File No. 15/0307 - Kurunegala
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property details. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
